description: This Java class 'FileHistory' models the history of a file uploaded or stored within the sales manager system, capturing metadata such as size, dates, download count, and associated merchant store.

classes.name: FileHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing the file history record with fields like id, store, fileId, filesize, dateAdded, dateDeleted, accountedDate, and downloadCount. Mapped to 'FILE_HISTORY' table with schema and constraints.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the file history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the file history record.

methods.name: setStore
methods.description: Associates this record with a MerchantStore.

methods.name: getFileId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the file.

methods.name: setFileId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the file.

methods.name: getFilesize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: setFilesize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getDateAdded
methods.description: Returns the date the file was added, cloned to prevent external modification.

methods.name: setDateAdded
methods.description: Sets the date the file was added, cloning the date object.

methods.name: getDateDeleted
methods.description: Returns the date the file was deleted, cloned.

methods.name: setDateDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deletion date of the file, cloning the provided date.

methods.name: getAccountedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the file was accounted, cloned.
